**- What I did**

Fix #40939

**- How I did it**


`ReplaceAll(lower, ":", "\\:")`, because lowerdir needs escaping:
https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/v5.4/fs/overlayfs/super.c#L835-L853


**- How to verify it**

Run `docker pull osixia/phpldapadmin:stable` on rootless with overlay2 on Ubuntu/Debian.

issue_context.title: Failed to registrer layer when docker pull with Docker Rootless
issue_context.body:
Hi,

I am using Docker Rootless mode and encounter a problem while pulling an image.

A `docker pull osixia/phpldapadmin:stable` or any of its version (`:latest`, `:0.9.0` etc...) leads to this error message :

```
latest: Pulling from osixia/phpldapadmin
1ab2bdfe9778: Already exists
0abcaf321aa9: Already exists
6d688c3d4e02: Already exists
454331b99b9a: Pull complete
5cada7c8cb4e: Pull complete
b0f406024ee7: Pull complete
b04a43f9c3ac: Pull complete
92a3a5c2b5a5: Extracting [==================================================>]  34.17kB/34.17kB
e4955dcfbe65: Download complete
failed to register layer: Error processing tar file(exit status 1): failed to mknodChar0UserNS("/container/service/:apache2/install.sh"): failed to mount overlay (lowerdir=/container/service/:apache2/mc0o793276857/l,upperdir=/container/service/:apache2/mc0o793276857/u,workdir=/container/service/:apache2/mc0o793276857/w) on /container/service/:apache2/mc0o793276857/m: no such file or directory
```

Docker version : `19.03.8, build afacb8b7f0`  
OS : Ubuntu 18.04 (bionic)

It works perfectly fine on a classic non-rootless Docker install.   
I did not experience the problem with any other image yet.

- Would you have an idea why it fails ?

Thank you,

The workaround works !

dmesg showing weird error: `overlayfs: failed to resolve 'apache2/mc0o316710287/l': -2`

The printed path doesn't contain `:` symbol. Probably the issue is related to the filename.

The kernel isn't happy with ':' symbol in the filenames:
```console
suda@suda-ws01:/tmp/a$ ls -Rl
.:
total 4
drwxrwxr-x 3 suda suda 4096 May 12 13:13 foo

./foo:
total 4
drwxrwxr-x 6 suda suda 4096 May 12 13:12 :bar

'./foo/:bar':
total 16
drwxrwxr-x 2 suda suda 4096 May 12 13:13 l
drwxrwxr-x 2 suda suda 4096 May 12 13:12 m
drwxrwxr-x 2 suda suda 4096 May 12 13:12 u
drwxrwxr-x 2 suda suda 4096 May 12 13:15 w

'./foo/:bar/l':
total 0
-rw-rw-r-- 1 suda suda 0 May 12 13:13 dummy

'./foo/:bar/m':
total 0

'./foo/:bar/u':
total 0

'./foo/:bar/w':
total 0
suda@suda-ws01:/tmp/a$ unshare -rm
root@suda-ws01:/tmp/a# mount -t overlay -o lowerdir=foo/:bar/l,upperdir=foo/:bar/u,workdir=foo/:bar/w overlay foo/\:bar/m
mount: /tmp/a/foo/:bar/m: special device overlay does not exist.
root@suda-ws01:/tmp/a# dmesg
...
[115335.292782] overlayfs: failed to resolve 'bar/l': -2

```

It seems we need to escape `:` symbol

review_comments:
Does the same apply  to `upper` and `work`?

Wondering if we should have a `clean(path string)` function to handle this, and then;

```suggestion
	mOpts := fmt.Sprintf("lowerdir=%s,upperdir=%s,workdir=%s", clean(lower), clean(upper), clean(work))
```

Or perhaps do it in one go, something like;

```suggestion
	mOpts := fmt.Sprintf("lowerdir=%s,upperdir=%s,workdir=%s", lowerEscaped, upper, work)
	mOpts = clean(mOpts)
```
Specific to lowerdir (because it can be comma-sepatated list)
